step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture depicts the integration between a customer's AWS account and Kaleido's enterprise blockchain platform. In the customer AWS account, SQS receives incoming JSON event payloads and triggers a Lambda function. Lambda transforms the payloads into transaction requests and forwards them over AWS PrivateLink to Kaleido's ETHConnect REST API interface. ETHConnect routes transactions into a Kafka streaming layer partitioned by account nonce to handle ordering and consensus propagation onto the underlying Blockchain. AWS KMS manages master keys for identity signing, CloudWatch collects operational node logs, S3 stores node backups, and IPFS handles off-chain storage with on-chain hashes.

edges.notes: SQS passes JSON payloads to Lambda.
Lambda forwards JSON transactions over PrivateLink.
PrivateLink connects directly to ETHConnect REST interface.
ETHConnect streams transactions into Kafka partitions based on nonces.
Kafka delivers ordered transactions onto the Blockchain.
ETHConnect verifies identities against on-chain Registry.
IPFS stores off-chain files and writes cryptographic hashes to Blockchain.
